gaps.sentence: The novel was translated ___ twelve languages.
gaps.explanation: translate FROM one language INTO another.

gaps.sentence: He's brilliant ___ solving all kinds of puzzles.
gaps.explanation: Adjectives of skill take 'at': brilliant at something.

gaps.sentence: She soon got tired ___ answering the same questions.
gaps.explanation: tired OF something = bored/annoyed by it; tired FROM = physically exhausted.

gaps.sentence: Millions suffer ___ hay fever every summer.
The film is based ___ a true story.
This perfume always reminds me ___ my grandmother.
gaps.explanation: 'Remind somebody of something' = make them think of it.
